title: A bill to designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 1 Walter Hammond Place in Waldwick, New Jersey, as the "Staff Sergeant Joseph D'Augustine Post Office Building".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

This bill designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 1 Walter Hammond Place in Waldwick, New Jersey, as the "Staff Sergeant Joseph D'Augustine Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Names a New Jersey post office in Waldwick after Staff Sergeant Joseph D'Augustine.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 1 Walter Hammond Place in Waldwick, New Jersey. The building will be officially called the "Staff Sergeant Joseph D'Augustine Post Office Building." It is a ceremonial change that honors the named person and does not change how the post office operates.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on October 7, 2015, and the name change took effect on that date.
